mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced business investment, which lowers earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when PAYEMS exceeds 6.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts below 1.2 million annualized for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1.2 million for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 1.2 million for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index below 99.0 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 99.0 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls below 99.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals an inflationary shock that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
